summary: Iteration 2 (Lexicon + Arrival Moment + Living Canvas + Quiet Memory) fully verified. Backend: 6/6 new tests pass (Hindsight reflect creates domain-valid reflections with provenance and dedup; empty conversation returns []; list is newest-first; DELETE removes; PATCH artifact replaces ordinal-th inner content and persists; 404 on missing message). Regression suite: 12/12 pass after correcting one outdated default-title assertion (title now 'Untitled' per new lexicon). Frontend: sidebar shows 'Begin a page' and 'What I understand'; sending 'I prefer concise answers and I journal every evening' produces reflections that appear in the memory drawer grouped by domain; forget-btn removes one reflection; memory-close-btn closes drawer. Living Canvas: canvas-edit-btn -> canvas-edit-input -> canvas-save-btn persists edits (reopen shows EDITED_BY_TEST_MARKER); canvas-cancel-btn discards. Model-agnosticism holds across body, memory drawer, and canvas — no gpt/openai/claude/gemini/anthropic tokens anywhere in the visible UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~645 lines. Reflect+artifact+storage+streaming all in one file; would benefit from being split into gaia/{storage,tools,hermes,hindsight,artifacts}.py modules.

hindsight_reflect dedup uses a global regex-based summary lookup with $regex + $options: 'i' on unindexed field — fine for small collections but O(N) per call; add an index on reflections.summary (case-insensitive) if this grows.

hindsight_reflect swallows all LlmChat exceptions silently (logger.warning + return []). Consider surfacing a non-2xx response type or an 'error' field so the frontend can distinguish 'model failed' from 'nothing durable'.

replace_nth_artifact silently no-ops if ordinal is out of range — the PATCH endpoint returns 200 with unchanged content. Consider returning 404/400 when the ordinal doesn't match any artifact so the UI can inform the user.

Frontend fires reflect() as best-effort after each turn but does not refresh the drawer automatically; the review request already flags this. Consider a lightweight refresh when the drawer is open (poll or invalidate on 'done' SSE).
seed_data_creation: Reflections are LLM-generated per test conversation; conversation is deleted in fixture teardown but reflections persist in Mongo. list_and_delete_flow deletes the one it creates. Consider a broader cleanup of test-created reflections if this suite is run many times.
context_for_next_testing_agent: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported before pytest (root pytest.ini uses -n 2 --dist loadscope). All new endpoints: POST /api/hindsight/reflect {conversation_id}; GET /api/hindsight/reflections; DELETE /api/hindsight/reflections/{id}; PATCH /api/hermes/conversations/{cid}/messages/{mid}/artifact {ordinal, content}. Reflect uses a live LLM (5–20s); the test file uses 90s timeouts. Duplicate summaries are silently skipped (empty second-call reflections is expected). The Conversation default title is now 'Untitled' (lexicon change). New data-testids: open-memory-btn, memory-drawer, memory-close-btn, memory-empty, reflection-item, forget-btn, canvas-edit-btn, canvas-edit-input, canvas-save-btn, canvas-cancel-btn.
